title: Bigger body feel and fuel tank size
summary: This topic mixes comments about a bigger fuel tank and range with separate remarks about the car feeling or becoming bigger in size, so the sample is not a single coherent issue.

positive.summary: Positive feedback highlights a bigger fuel tank as improving economy and running range.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined comments mention a bigger fuel tank, a larger body feel, parking or size concerns, motorway ride over bigger road markers, and model-switching context without a clear overall sentiment.

limitations: Most examples are assigned undetermined sentiment, so clear evaluative conclusions are limited.
The cluster mixes unrelated subjects including fuel tank size, overall vehicle size, ride behavior, and previous vehicle history.
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all reviews on this topic.
